name: Robert Spierenburg
career_history: Director Commercial Sales Europe North at Digital Realty, 1/2026 to present; Account Director at Digital Realty, 7/2016 to 1/2026; Senior Account Manager at TelecityGroup, 9/2015 to 6/2016;  Ingénieur Commercial at TelecityGroup, 12/2012 to 12/2015; Senior Account Manager at TelecityGroup, 12/2010 to 12/2012;  Account Manager at TelecityGroup, 12/2008 to 12/2010; Sales Consultant at Rackspace, 6/2007 to 11/2008; Account manager at BT Global Services, 2005 to 2007
education: Bachelor, Finance Management, Corporate Communication, International Marketing, Marketing Planning and –Strate, HBO Nederland, 1999 to 2002
biography:
"I lead by putting trust first, knowing that in the data center industry, trust is the ultimate competitive advantage" 

With extensive experience in data center industry, I specialize in data center solutions and account management, helping clients achieve results while building strong, lasting partnerships.

Passionate about people, results, and continuous improvement. I believe that when you combine good skills, vision, courage, perseverance with integrity and empathy, growth isn't just possible, it's inevitable. 

I'm here to inspire, achieve, and make a difference: one client, one team, and one goal at a time.
